tweets.text:
So bullish on MCP. Its utility exceeds the "M" part: even AI aside, it'll be a civilization-scale accomplishment to get all our systems communicating through one universal open protocol.

A missing piece was how to get arbitrary callbacks across sessions. MCP could read and write, but it couldn't tell you later "this event happened." MCP Events fixes this.

We're adding support in our own MCP. Say an agent makes a deployment, and wants to know when it's complete. Instead of polling, it can subscribe to 𝚍𝚎𝚙𝚕𝚘𝚢𝚖𝚎𝚗𝚝.𝚜𝚞𝚌𝚌𝚎𝚎𝚍𝚎𝚍.

PSA: With Vercel Queues and Workflows, writing the backend machinery for your own MCPs to do this is easy peasy.

At @vercel we got to test this model before release. Best way to summarize it: astonishingly brilliant.

One interesting takeaway: it's very clear that this new generation of models can take on unprecedented bodies of parallel work.

To actually seize this intelligence, you need cloud sandboxes. Full stop. The model can delegate and orchestrate far more than a single computer can handle. Likely far more than you can even imagine it can handle.

Your bottleneck is now ① your ambition and ② your parallel computing power.

Btw, I learned from @cramforce you don't need to overcomplicate it. Install Vercel CLI, setup the Plugin and tell the agent to use /𝚘𝚏𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚊𝚍-𝚝𝚘-𝚜𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚋𝚘𝚡 skill. It'll provision and de-allocate cloud sandboxes as needed. You don't need a "multi-agent remote harness ralph orchestrator" 😆

tweets.text:
If you are a product leader, here is a simple exercise: draw out your product lifecycle.

e.g. market understanding -> design -> development -> GTM.

Chances are your PMs spend more time in some stages than others - because of the nature of your product, your org or their comfort zones.

This is a handoff-heavy, lossy process.

Now ask yourself: using AI, how much deeper can PMs go on every stage?

PMs should be able to
- build a much deeper, broader understanding of users and the market
- iterate fast from ideas to working prototypes
- explore the codebase to study technical constraints and tradeoffs
- run their own analytics and investigate questions as they emerge
- understand the GTM funnel deeply enough to shape product strategy

Now, this is not about PMs replacing every role. As the function that spans the entire lifecycle, this is about  raising the bar on the PM role, so they combine their breadth with much greater depth.

BREAKING:

@AnthropicAI just dropped Claude Fable 5.2. It’s a paradigm-shifting model if you have a project ambitious enough to give it.

We’ve been testing it at @every, and I’ve seen this crazy explosion of creativity on the team. People are making their own creative software, games for their kids, and documentaries instead of slide decks.

Here’s your day zero vibe check:

• Coding: @kieranklaassen built Everycut, a video editor with the features we use from Premiere, Descript, and other tools—all in one app, with an agent built in. The first version was live in 3 days, and we immediately used it for our internal show-and-tell. This feels like a new era of professionals building their own professional tools, tailored to exactly how they work.

• Games and design: @jackcheng gave it a photo of his toddler’s messy playroom. It turned the actual toys into a playable racing game, with fun details like a stray shoe as an obstacle and a sippy cup as a power-up.

• Knowledge work: @hammer_mt turned his research into a documentary. The model came up with interview questions, he answered them on camera, and it cut the footage together. He called this the most productive 3 weeks of his career.

• A different way of working: Give it a big job and leave it running overnight or over a weekend. But tell it what “done” means: Mike found it could finish the build, then spend another day or two testing. Set the goal, the budget, and how much checking you need before walking away.

• The catch: It’s slow and burns through tokens. Our early-access usage was free, and these projects would have been expensive at API rates. It’s 20% cheaper than Fable 5.1, but for everyday writing, emails, or quick back-and-forth coding, I’d usually reach for something else.

The clearest signal: When our early access ended, @TylerNishida stopped working on some projects until he could get this model back. He didn’t want to build them with anything else.

The best measure of a new model is whether it makes you try things you wouldn’t have tried before.

Fable 5.2 absolutely does that.

tweets.text:
黄仁勋早在一年前就请了危机公关，专门帮名人处理丑闻。

据《连线》（WIRED）援引知情人士透露，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋早在 2025 年 10 月，就开始与危机公关公司 Heller 合作，比他 11 月 8 日公开承认婚外情早了一年多。

这家公关公司很有意思，创始人 Risa Heller 专门处理名人舆论危机，尤其擅长应对性不端行为指控。此前服务过美国前国会议员、知名厨师和作家。

更值得注意的是：

▪️ Heller 最初主要负责黄仁勋的私人事务，包括家庭及慈善活动，团队经常与黄仁勋及其女儿 Madison Huang 沟通。

▪️ 2025 年 10 月，《纽约时报》曾调查英伟达与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的商业往来，并披露黄仁勋与该公司高管关系密切。

▪️ 报道引发英伟达高层紧张，月底公司内部公关团队甚至收到指示：此后媒体询问黄仁勋，无论涉及私人生活还是公司业务，都必须先经过 Heller。

一年多前就开始部署危机公关，如今董事会又启动独立调查。

这场风波显然不只是一次简单的 CEO 私生活争议，也让外界开始关注英伟达内部的管理、声誉风险与公司治理。

Anthropic 估值预期缩水近万亿美元，还是决定硬闯 IPO。

据消息人士透露，Anthropic 计划通过 IPO 募资至多 693 亿美元，发行 8.67 亿股 A 类股，发行价区间为每股 70 至 80 美元。路透社旗下 IFR 报道称，公司将于当地时间周二上午启动纳斯达克 IPO 路演。

但这次 IPO 面临的市场环境，已经和几个月前大不相同。

此前 Anthropic 的潜在估值预期一度高达 2 万亿美元。美股 AI 板块暴跌前，市场讨论的合理估值也在 1.4 万亿至 1.5 万亿美元。

如今，潜在买家讨论的估值区间已经降至 1.2 万亿至 1.3 万亿美元，部分投资者甚至考虑 1.1 万亿美元。

民主党横扫国会、AI 数据中心扩张可能面临更严格的监管审查，再叠加近期 AI 股集体回调，正在重新定价整个行业的增长预期。

有意思的是，Anthropic 并没有选择推迟上市，而是继续按计划推进。

从 2 万亿美元到 1.1 万亿美元，市场对 AI 公司的估值逻辑正在发生变化。

Anthropic 这场 IPO，或许也将成为检验 AI 资本热度的一次重要压力测试。

冰箱也成了网络战的攻击目标。

法国于 11 月 9 日正式指认伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队网络部队，幕后操纵了 10 月针对法国超市冷藏系统的大规模网络攻击。

此次攻击涉及约 700 家零售场所。黑客远程篡改冰柜温度设置、关闭安全警报，导致大量生鲜和冷冻食品变质，部分设备甚至起火，至少造成 15 起火灾。

法国已召见伊朗大使，并宣布推动欧盟对相关责任方实施制裁。巴黎检方同时对伊朗网络组织 Shahid Kaveh 展开司法调查，并申请对其负责人及两名副手发布国际逮捕令。

值得注意的是，这并非单纯的数据窃取或系统瘫痪，而是直接针对现实世界基础设施的网络破坏。

从超市冷柜到工业控制系统，网络攻击正在从虚拟空间延伸到食品供应链和实体经济。

以太坊基金会前员工起诉V神：癌症诊断后13天被开除，只因反对“切腹自尽”的内部文件

以太坊基金会前协议支持负责人Kayleen Fulton（社区称Nixo）11月4日在美国科罗拉多联邦法院起诉基金会、联合执行董事Bastian Aue以及V神本人。

起诉书称，基金会董事会在今年2月25日向全体员工分发了一份内部《授权书》，明确写着“如果基金会未能履行对以太坊的庄严承诺，愿其自食其果/自刎”。

随后79名员工投票要求删除这一条约。但在3月13日发布的最终版中仍保留该条款原文，并将其做成卡通风格图片：一本打开的书，配上眨眼的动漫少女和几只黄色卡通猫，整体带故障效果（图2）。起诉书指出，这一视觉风格借鉴了Milady Maker的美学。整份文件后来被永久写入以太坊链上。

3月20日，联合执行董事Bastian Aue向全体员工发出最后通牒：必须亲自承诺该文件，否则视为自动辞职。

Nixo正值此际被诊断出卵巢癌，3月24日，她书面告知基金会领导层自己患癌，并请求不要改变雇佣状态。次日（3月25日），她与同事组织53名协议团队员工联名，反对被迫签署该文件，并明确表示“不辞职”。4月6日，组织联名的两人被开除。

Nixo在离职说明中称，自己被开除不是因为没签，而是因为“公开异议和组织批评”。

11月4日，Nixo在美国科罗拉多联邦法院起诉以太坊基金会及其关联实体、联合执行董事Bastian Aue以及V神本人。
她指控对方存在残疾歧视与报复行为，并干预了她的家庭医疗休假权利。

起诉书称，解雇约三周后，V神在与她的对话中把此事解释为不想“奖励闹事”：如果靠闹事就能拿到结果，那以后大家都会知道，在内部和外部闹一闹，就是影响基金会决策的方式。

Nixo目前仍在癌症治疗中，健康保险在第二次手术前已终止。

Elliptic最新分析显示，与币安64亿美元被盗案相关的洗钱人员，正在通过自己创建的几乎没有真实流动性的meme币，在DEX的流动性池中转移赃款，目前手法已出现在Tron、NEAR和Solana上。

其中最清晰的案例发生在NEAR：11月5日至7日，洗钱人员创建了至少6个meme代币，包括：

·FUK（11月5日创建）
·OLCCL、MEILI、MMLI、DABI（11月6日创建）
·INU（11月7日创建）

这些代币都与NEAR配对建池，每个创建成本约90美元。被盗NEAR从一组钱包买入代币，再由另一组钱包卖出提取NEAR。六个代币合计流转约11.7万枚NEAR（按当时价格约43万美元）。

所有交易几乎全部由洗钱网络内部钱包完成，几乎没有外部买家。这种手法成本极低，每个代币用完即弃，主要目的是增加追踪难度。

Elliptic表示，目前尚未移动的被盗NEAR仍有约1180万枚（约4370万美元）。

老黄的瓜成为今天焦点的同时，大家可能都没注意到 Vitalik 其实写了篇长文，来讨论 ETH 后续的价值。

而这也许会改变 ETH 的估值逻辑和走向。

省流版就是，V 亲手打破了之前 ETH 燃烧通缩的叙事，将 ETH 的估值逻辑切换成了“价值储存”。

在 2021 至 2023 年的周期中，市场为 ETH 打造了一个完美的净现值（NPV）模型：
市值 = 每年燃烧手续费 / 贴现率。

大家笃信，只要链上活动繁荣，不断销毁的 ethereum:native  就能托起一个坚实的理论底价。

但 Vitalik 坦言这个幻象十分脆弱：巅峰期的燃烧量，绝大部分来自生态内部的杠杆与投机（例如单日烧掉 1.8 亿美元手续费的 Yuga Labs 虚拟土地发售）。

一旦进入熊市，这部分利润和购买力会瞬间蒸发。

更现实的是，随着 Layer 2 对主网流量的彻底抽离，以太坊的燃烧机制已名存实亡。

Vitalik 在文中承认，若要单纯靠燃烧利润来支撑当下约 2700 亿美元的市值，以太坊将被迫采取极度激进的商业化运营，而这会直接摧毁其“去中心化与抗审查”的底线。

为了保住基本盘，Vitalik 给出了务实的新解法：退守价值储存 （SoV, Store 。

他指出，以太坊真正的护城河是去中心化带来的“稳定性”。

在 AI 颠覆一切的时代，稳定性本身就是资产配置的刚需，所以把 ETH 作为价值储存（Store of Value）不仅是意识形态的选择，更是最务实的商业定位。

放弃产生现金流的“科技股”执念，转身对标“数字黄金”。ETH 的估值逻辑，在这个转折点彻底换锚了。

只是，目前 ETH 终究不是 BTC ，这个价值储存叙事，在代币设计和社区认可层面上，还有很长的路要走。

tweets.text: elysium, kinetiq's new network built on hyperliquid, opened on november 9. aero, the merged aerodrome and velodrome dex, traded there on day one. its elysium pools did $147,285 of volume, about 0.017% of aero's $878m total that day. they earned $106 for staked aero holders. fees reach those holders only from pools that take aero rewards, so new flow must reach those pools. one day does not show the recurring size.

world liberty financial says it has started buying its own wlfi governance token on aster, a crypto exchange. its disclosed wallet sent 10m usd1, its dollar stablecoin, to aster on november 7. that is about 24% of wlfi's daily trading volume, but the amount actually bought is not disclosed. the plan can draw on usd1 reserve income, and usd1 supply fell 21.7% in a month. so that funding source is shrinking, but other sources could still pay for buying.

avalanche was picked on november 9 to supply the core ledger for the clearing firm behind a planned nyse-affiliated venue for tokenized us stocks and etfs. the launch target is q4 2026, but it still needs regulatory approval. avalanche's dedicated chains for institutions burn a fixed fee of about 1.33 avax per validator each month. if the venue uses that model, more trading would not mean a matching rise in avax demand. the deal's token terms are not disclosed.

builders.name: Cosmos
builders.bio: The internet of blockchains.

tweets.text:
We envision a global financial system where independent digital ledgers and financial networks can exchange assets and data as freely as people share data online.

Networks are one of the greatest tools for human flourishing.

IBC is the open standard that will make it happen.

We look forward to continuing this work with the global IBC community and to making open, secure connectivity a shared industry standard.

https://t.co/ivhQWRXALE

What does this move change for the companies and people who rely on IBC-powered products today?

IBC will remain free and open source, as always.

Existing chains, apps, and services will continue to communicate and transfer assets over the public IBC network, just as they do today.

The Cosmos team will remain a long-term maintainer of IBC, and 2 more maintainers are joining: Datachain and OpenZeppelin.

Together, we will support IBC’s development and technical roadmap.

An incredible ecosystem of code contributors has supported IBC's growth over time.

From adding new features to innovating on how the protocol works, teams like Agoric, @irisnetwork, @binary_builders, @chainapsis, @ChorusOne, @OmnityNetwork, @confio_tech, Datachain, @SuccinctLabs, @informalinc, @iqlusioninc, @osmosis, and many others have redefined what’s possible.

We are grateful to the open source community for their contributions, innovation, and expansion of the protocol.
